newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Athlon to buy French car rental firm.
newsitem.headline: Athlon to buy French car rental firm.

text.p: Athlon Groep NV said on Wednesday it was planning to buy French car rental and lease company Financieres G.G. Jean Jaures.
Athlon said it expected to finalise the takeover, which is seen contributing to Athlon's group result from the start, in July 1997.

Jean Jaures has annual turnover of 230 million French francs. It is currently 55 percent owned by a consortium of investment funds, for 25 percent by Barclays Capital Development SA and the remaining 20 percent is in the hands of the management of the group.
Athlon said the takeover would be financed through subordinated loans, enabling the group to keep its balance sheet ratios within the set norms.
